title: Thyroid ultrasound
what: The doctor looks at the thyroid gland in your neck with ultrasound: its size, structure, and any lumps, called nodules.
why: For abnormal hormone levels, a lump you can feel, a swollen neck, or a routine checkup.
tell_doctor: If nodules were found before, bring your past reports

prepare.title: Preparation
prepare.text: None needed. Eat and drink as usual.

prepare.title: Clothes
prepare.text: No high collar. It is best to take off any neck chain.

bring: Past ultrasounds and thyroid hormone tests, if you have them
steps: You lie on your back with a roll under your shoulders, so your head tilts back a little
Gel is put on your neck
The probe moves over the front of your neck
Sometimes you are asked to swallow
feel: Cool gel and light pressure from the probe
after: The report is usually given right away
If a nodule is found, the doctor may suggest a needle biopsy. That is a separate procedure

faq.a: Most nodules are harmless. The doctor checks them on ultrasound and orders a needle biopsy if needed.
